provenance.summary: Synthetic reduction of the token-spend report's gaps: an unpriced model and missing usage must stay unknown, never zero.

pre_fix_state.description: spend.py reports 0.0 for an unpriced model and treats missing usage as zero tokens.

reference.description: Report null cost, incomplete, with a reason flag, for an unpriced model or missing usage.

zero-for-unknown.description: Flags the record as incomplete but still reports a cost of zero.

drop-flags.description: Reports null cost but claims the record is complete and gives no reason.
